title: Mixed Conditionals / Shartiyada Kala duwan
bridge: Af-Soomaaliga, shartiyada kala duwan ma lehno qaab u eg yaraan: waxaynu u isticmaalaa kala duwan oo waqtiga afka ee ay u fiicanyihiin go’aan la xiriiray ee ay leedahay natiijo oo hadda ayusoo noqotay, ama shuruudda hadda ayusoo noqotay ee ay leedahay natiijo oo dhintay. Ingiriisi, kala duwanaasha waxay u qoran yihiin qaab joogto ah: protasis (qaybta if) iyo apodosis (qaybta siyaasiyada) waxay isticmaalaan waqtiga afka oo xusuusan oo aanan la wada adagayn waxa uu hadaladii af-Soomaali ayay isticmaali lahaayeen. Khilaafkii ugu weyn waa inaad kuma tarjimi karo shartiyada af-Soomaali si adag ah u Ingiriisi; waa inaad ku qabsato qaabka midkooda oo kala duwan oo laba iyo inaad ogaatid goormay isticmaali lahaayeen.
rule: Shartiyada kala duwan waxay kala soocaan shart oo dhintay ee ay leedahay natiijo oo hadda ayusoo noqotay (noocyada 3 + 2) ama shart oo hadda ayusoo noqotay ee ay leedahay natiijo oo dhintay (noocyada 2 + 3). Qalabka 1: If + dhintay u dambeeyay, waxayno qaadan lahaayeen + fiilka asas (shart dhintay, natiijo hadda ayusoo noqotay). Misaal: If I had studied harder, I would have a better job now. Qalabka 2: If + dhintay u dambeeyay, waxayno qaadan lahaayeen + qaybta qaybta qaybta (shart hadda ayusoo noqotay, natiijo dhintay). Misaal: If I were you, I would have told her the truth. Khilaafyo: Shartiyada kala duwan, waxay amaanaantahay inaad isticmaashid 'were' oo ka badan 'was' oo dhan oo dadka ah ee shart hadda ayusoo noqotay (If I were...). Si kastaba ha ahaatee, xarunta qaybaha waxay u badali kartaa aanay u badalin manaqoolka, laakiin midigta waxay isticmaalaysaa markii shartku wuxuu ku jiraa hore.

concept_examples.text: If I had studied more, I would be more confident now.
concept_examples.translation: Haddii aan u darsan lahaa si badan, hadda waxaan lahaa imtixaanka.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ hæd ˈstʌdid mɔːr, aɪ wʊd biː mɔːr ˈkɑːnfɪdənt naʊ/

concept_examples.text: If she were more organized, she would have finished the project yesterday.
concept_examples.translation: Haddii ay tidhiidhii u ahayd si fiican u qarnayn, ayay dhibay ku guuleystay.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf ʃiː wɜːr mɔːr ˈɔːrɡənaɪzd, ʃiː wʊd hæv ˈfɪnɪʃt ðə ˈprɒdʒekt ˈjestərdeɪ/

concept_examples.text: If I hadn't missed the flight, I wouldn't be stuck in this hotel.
concept_examples.translation: Haddii aanay helinay furaadada, aanu kuma noqon lahaa ku dhacay.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ ˈhædənt mɪst ðə flaɪt, aɪ ˈwʊdənt biː stʌk ɪn ðɪs hoʊˈtel/

concept_examples.text: If he were here, he would have solved the problem easily.
concept_examples.translation: Haddii uu halkan joogay, ayuu u guuleystay dhibaatooyinka.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf hiː wɜːr hɪr, hiː wʊd hæv sɑːlvd ðə ˈprɑːbləm ˈiːzəli/

common_error.wrong: If I would have known, I would have told you.
common_error.correct: If I had known, I would have told you.
common_error.correct_alt: Had I known, I would have told you.
common_error.explanation: Tanu waa khalad bayn ah oo ku nool hadaladii af-Soomaali maxaa yeelay af-Soomaaliga waxay leeyihiin 'Haddii aan oggolaan lahaa', laakiin Ingiriisi shartku ma isticmaali 'would' midkoodna. Protasis (qaybta if) waxay isticmaalaan 'dhintay u dambeeyay' aan 'would' lahayn. Inaad ka saartid, xusuuso in 'would' waxay ku soo baxay qaybta siyaasiyada (natiijo). Waxaad isticmaal kartaa qalabka la soo jeediyey aan 'if' lahayn ee fiilku ugu horeeyo: 'Had I known...'.

levels.label: Mixed Conditional Type 1: Past Condition, Present Result
levels.translation: Shartiyada kala duwan Noocyada 1: Shart dhintay, Natiijo hadda ayusoo noqotay

examples.original: If I had taken that job, I would be living in Madrid now.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ hæd ˈteɪkən ðæt dʒɒb, aɪ wʊd biː ˈlɪvɪŋ ɪn məˈdrɪd naʊ/
examples.translation: Haddii aan qaadan lahaa shuqulkaas, hadda waxaan noqon lahaa ku woqooyi.
examples.note: Shartku wuxuu dhintay (had taken) iyo natiijada hadda ayusoo noqotay (would be living). Af-Soomaaliga waxay isticmaalaan subjunctive pluscuamperfect ee shartku iyo conditional simple ee natiijada.

examples.original: If we hadn't argued, we would still be friends.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf wiː ˈhædənt ˈɑːrɡjuːd, wiː wʊd stɪl biː frendz/
examples.translation: Haddii aanan la kulminay, waxaan lahaa saaxiibbad.
examples.note: Isticmaalka adagga 'still' (todavía) waxay amaanaantahay sharciga kala duwan ee sharciga si ay u cadhoonayso in natiijada hadda ayusoo noqotay.

levels.label: Mixed Conditional Type 2: Present Condition, Past Result
levels.translation: Shartiyada kala duwan Noocyada 2: Shart hadda ayusoo noqotay, Natiijo dhintay

examples.original: If I were more careful, I wouldn't have made that mistake.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ wɜːr mɔːr ˈkerfəl, aɪ ˈwʊdənt hæv meɪd ðæt mɪˈsteɪk/
examples.translation: Haddii aan ahayn si fiican u qarnayn, aanu kuma qaadan lahaa khaladkaas.
examples.note: Shartku hadda ayusoo noqotay (if I were) iyo natiijada dhintay (wouldn't have made). Xusuuso ina isticmaalo 'were' oo dhan oo dadka ah ee shart, haddii ay ahayd rasmi ah.

examples.original: If she spoke English better, she would have understood the movie.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ʃiː spoʊk ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈbetər, ʃiː wʊd hæv ˌʌndərˈstʊd ðə ˈmuːvi/
examples.translation: Haddii ay hadalaysay Ingiriisi si fiican, ayay fahmaystay fiilmka.
examples.note: Waxaynu isticmaalaa 'if + dhintay u dambeeyay' ee shart (hadda ayusoo noqotay) iyo 'would have + qaybta qaybta' ee natiijo (dhintay). Af-Soomaaliga, laba fiilku waxay ku noqon doonaan subjunctive/conditional.

levels.label: Inverted and Reduced Mixed Conditionals
levels.translation: Shartiyada kala duwan la soo jeediyey iyo la soo jeediyey

examples.original: Had I known about the meeting, I would be there now.
examples.phonetic: /hæd aɪ noʊn əˈbaʊt ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ, aɪ wʊd biː ðer naʊ/
examples.translation: Haddii aan oggolaan lahaa shirka, hadda waxaan ku noqon lahaa.
examples.note: La soo jeedi rasmi ah aan 'if' lahayn waxay u fiican tahay iyo waxay isticmaalaysaa si badan oo kalena qoraalka ama akhreeyaha. Qalabkan, shartku wuxuu dhintay iyo natiijada hadda ayusoo noqotay.

examples.original: Were I in your position, I would have accepted the offer.
examples.phonetic: /wɜːr aɪ ɪn jɔːr pəˈzɪʃən, aɪ wʊd hæv əkˈseptɪd ði ˈɒfər/
examples.translation: Haddii aan ahayn meeshaada, waxaan qaadan lahaa su’aasha.
examples.note: Qalabka la soo jeediyey 'Were I...' waxay u eg tahay 'If I were...' iyo waxay isticmaalaysaa si ay u fududaan rasmi ah. Qalabkan waxay u eg yahay la soo jeedi 'Had I...'.

examples.original: If you hadn't lied, we would trust you now.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf juː ˈhædənt laɪd, wiː wʊd trʌst juː naʊ/
examples.translation: Haddii aanan ku dhex dhigeen, hadda waxaan rumaynay.
examples.note: Misalkaan waxay bixiyaa isticmaalka amaanaanta ah: dhibaatooyinka ee dhintay ee ay leedahay natiijo hadda ayusoo noqotay. Fiilka 'trust' ee dhintay u dambeeyay ee ku soo socda 'would' waxay u fiican tahay maxaa yeelay waxay u cadhoonaysaa xaalad aan la qaran karo.

title: Advanced Passive Voice: Gerunds, Infinitives, and Modals / Sawirka qalad leh: Gerunds, Infinitives, iyo Modals
bridge: Af-Soomaaliga, sawirka qalad leh loo sameeyaa badanaa 'noqosh + shirka' waxaana natiijada u ah inaanu qalad leh u adeegsanayo inaanu u adeegsanayo qalad leh (gerund/infinitive). Af-Ingiriisihii, sawirka qalad leh waxay u badanaa: 'must be done', 'being done', 'to be done', iyo wixii la mid ah. Khalad caadan ah waa in lagu soo baxoo xogta Soomaaliga si taxaddar leh, sida 'waajiba in la sameeyo' oo kale 'has to be done'. Hadana, af-Ingiriisihii waxaa badan oo la dhaafayo shakhsiga (ma la yidhaa 'by someone' haddii ay jirin mid aan la qaadanayn), waxaana Soomaaliga waxay nuugtaa inaanu u adeegsanayo.
rule: Af-Ingiriisihii, sawirka qalad leh loo sameeyaa fiid u ah 'to be' in ay noqoto moddimo, moddimo ama midoobiyo aan la qaadanayn, oo la socda shirka ugu dambeeyey. Modals: modal + be + shirka (e.g. 'must be done', 'can be seen'). Infinitives: to be + shirka (e.g. 'to be considered'). Gerunds: being + shirka (e.g. 'being watched'). Modals oo dhan: modal + have been + shirka (e.g. 'should have been informed'). Hadana, waxay jiraan sawiro qalad leh oo leh preposition: 'This chair was sat on' (oo aan la mid ahayn). Fiirso inaad u adeegsanayso sawiro aan la qaadanayn (intransitive) iyo inaad u dhaafto shakhsiga: haddii aan loo baahnayn, waa in la dhaafaa. Soomaaliga, sawirka qalad leh waxay u badanaa oo ay u jeedaan sawirka qalad leh ama 'se' aan la qaadanayn.

concept_examples.text: The report must be submitted by Friday.
concept_examples.translation: Waxbarashada waa in la soo dejino Jimcaha.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə rɪˈpɔːrt mʌst biː səbˈmɪtɪd baɪ ˈfraɪdeɪ/

concept_examples.text: She enjoys being photographed.
concept_examples.translation: Ayay u faraxsan tahay in la soo qaado.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ɪnˈdʒɔɪz ˈbiːɪŋ ˈfoʊtəɡræft/

concept_examples.text: The problem needs to be solved immediately.
concept_examples.translation: Mishaanka waa in la helio si degdeg ah.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈprɑːbləm niːdz tə biː sɒlvd ɪˈmiːdiətli/

concept_examples.text: The package could have been delivered yesterday.
concept_examples.translation: Haaladdu ayuu u noqon lahaa in la soo dejino maalintii dabeecad.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈpækɪdʒ kʊd hæv biːn dɪˈlɪvərd ˈjestərdeɪ/

common_error.wrong: The problem must be solved *by us* immediately. (cuando no es necesario el agente)
common_error.correct: The problem must be solved immediately.
common_error.correct_alt: The problem has to be solved immediately.
common_error.explanation: Af-Soomaaliga waxay ku daraan shakhsiga 'by someone' maxaa yeelay Soomaaliga waxaa badan oo la soo galay 'naga' ama 'qof kale'. Af-Ingiriisihii, haddii shakhsiga ay noqoto mid aan la qaadanayn ama aan la qaadanayn, waa in la dhaafaa si ay u noqoto natural. Khalad kale waa 'has to be solved', oo waxay u badanaa inaanu u adeegsanayo. Ka tirso inaad u daranto macluumaad aan loo baahnayn.

examples.original: The rules can be changed.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ruːlz kæn biː tʃeɪndʒd/
examples.translation: Qaynuunnadaba waa in la beddelo.
examples.note: Isticmaal 'can be' si aad u qaadan kartid. Soomaaliga waxay nuugtaa inaanu u adeegsanayo 'ayay u qaadan karaan'.

examples.original: The application must be completed before noon.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˌæplɪˈkeɪʃən mʌst biː kəmˈpliːtɪd bɪˈfɔːr nuːn/
examples.translation: Baabuurta waa in la buuxiyo qorraxdhighe.
examples.note: 'Must be' waxay u cadhaysaa wajibaad. Soomaaliga waxay nuugtaa inaanu u adeegsanayo 'waajiba in la sameeyo'.

examples.original: This issue should be addressed immediately.
examples.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈɪʃuː ʃʊd biː əˈdrest ɪˈmiːdiətli/
examples.translation: Mishaanka waa in la eegayo si degdeg ah.
examples.note: 'Should be' waxay u cadhaysaa tashriic. Fiirso inaad u qaadan tahay 'should'.

examples.original: The meeting may be postponed if necessary.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ meɪ biː poʊstˈpoʊnd ɪf ˈnesəseri/
examples.translation: Iskaashiga ayaa la odhan karo in la soo dejino haddii loo baahnayo.
examples.note: 'May be' waxay u cadhaysaa aaminsan. Soomaaliga waxay nuugtaa inaanu u adeegsanayo 'ayay u qaadan karaan'.

examples.original: He dislikes being told what to do.
examples.phonetic: /hiː dɪsˈlaɪks ˈbiːɪŋ toʊld wɒt tə duː/
examples.translation: Ma uu jeclaa in la odhanayo wuxuu sameeyo.
examples.note: Soomaaliga waxay nuugtaa inaanu u adeegsanayo 'in la odhanayo', waxaana af-Ingiriisihii u adeegsanayo gerund qalad leh 'being told'.

examples.original: She is proud to be selected for the team.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ɪz praʊd tə biː sɪˈlektɪd fɔːr ðə tiːm/
examples.translation: Ayay u faan tahay in la doortay dhinacyada.
examples.note: Infinitive qalad leh 'to be selected' waxay u egtaa 'in la doortay' Soomaaliga.

examples.original: The data needs to be analyzed carefully.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈdeɪtə niːdz tə biː ˈænəlaɪzd ˈkerfəli/
examples.translation: Macluumaadka waa in la eegayo si fiican.
examples.note: 'Needs to be' + shirka. Soomaaliga waxay nuugtaa inaanu u adeegsanayo 'waa in la eegayo'.

examples.original: He admitted to being involved in the incident.
examples.phonetic: /hiː ədˈmɪtɪd tə ˈbiːɪŋ ɪnˈvɒlvd ɪn ðə ˈɪnsɪdənt/
examples.translation: Wuxuu aad u sheegay inuu la joogay dhibaatada.
examples.note: Gerund qalad leh 'being involved' waxay u egtaa 'in la joogay' Soomaaliga.

levels.label: Passive with Perfect Modals and Reporting Verbs
levels.translation: Sawirka qalad leh Modals oo dhan iyo sawiro xilliga

examples.original: The thief might have been caught by the police.
examples.phonetic: /ðə θiːf maɪt hæv biːn kɔːt baɪ ðə pəˈliːs/
examples.translation: Hallaayuhu ayuu u noqon lahaa in la qabto poliska.
examples.note: Isticmaal 'might have been' si aad u qaadan kartid waxa ay noqotay. Soomaaliga: 'ayay u noqon lahaa'.

examples.original: The documents should have been signed yesterday.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈdɒkjumənts ʃʊd hæv biːn saɪnd ˈjestərdeɪ/
examples.translation: Warqadaha ayay u noqon lahaa in la qaado maalintii dabeecad.
examples.note: Waxay u cadhaysaa sharci oo aan la sameeynayn. Soomaaliga: 'ayay u noqon lahaa'.

examples.original: The president is said to be considering new policies.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈprezɪdənt ɪz sed tə biː kənˈsɪdərɪŋ nuː ˈpɒləsiz/
examples.translation: Waxaa lagu yidhaahdaa in ra'iisku ayuu u eegaya macluumaad cusub.
examples.note: Xogta xilliga: 'is said to be' + gerund. Soomaaliga waxay nuugtaa inaanu u adeegsanayo 'waxaa lagu yidhaahdaa'.

examples.original: The lost city is believed to have been discovered in 2015.
examples.phonetic: /ðə lɒst ˈsɪti ɪz bɪˈliːvd tə hæv biːn dɪˈskʌvərd ɪn tuː ˈθaʊzənd ənd fɪfˈtiːn/
examples.translation: Waxaa lagu rumaystay in magaalada ayay la helay 2015.
examples.note: Sawirka qalad leh 'be believed to + have been + shirka' waxay u cadhaysaa in la soo galay waxa ay noqotay.

translations.so: Sawirka qalad leh: Gerunds, Infinitives, iyo Modals

title: Advanced Reported Speech / Qiyaastii la soo xigtay ee adag
bridge: Af-Soomaali, markaan u baxayno qiyaastii la soo xigtay, aan ku dhex maro waaqtiga fiilka oo ku nool yahay haddii fiilka u dhaafay qiyaastii ay noqoto inay hadda ah, laakiin Ingiriisi ah ayuu u qalad 'backshift' (dhexdhexaadka wakhtiga) markii fiilka u dhaafay qiyaastii ay noqoto inay hadda ah: 'She says she is tired' vs. 'She said she was tired'. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Ingiriisi ah ayuu u badanaa qiyaastii la soo xigtay ka badan Af-Soomaali: 'will' waxay noqotaa 'would', 'can' waxay noqotaa 'could', iyo waaqtiyada ugu horeeyay ayay ku noqdeen (past simple → past perfect). Kala duwan weyn oo kale waa in Ingiriisi ah ma ay isticmaalino 'subjunctive' qiyaastii la soo xigtay sida Af-Soomaali ('Dijo que viniera' → 'He said to come' ama 'He said that I should come'), iyo in erayada wakhtiga iyo meeshay ku noqdeen si adag oo ka badan (today → that day, here → there).
rule:
Qiyaastii la soo xigtay ee adag Ingiriisi ah (makiinka B2):
1. **Backshift (dhexdhexaadka wakhtiga)**: Haddii fiilka u dhaafay qiyaastii ay noqoto inay hadda ah (said, told, asked), waaqtiga fiilka qiyaastii la soo xigtay ayay ku noqdeen qiyaastii ugu horeeysay: present simple → past simple; present continuous → past continuous; past simple → past perfect; present perfect → past perfect; will → would; can → could; may → might; must → had to (ama must haddii ay noqoto inay wax walba ah).
2. **Backshift ma jiro**: Dhexdhexaad ma jirto haddii xaaladdan weli qumman yahay ama u adag yahay markii la hadlayo (haddii ay la doonayo): 'He said he is ill' (weli waa dembiyey) ama 'He said he was ill' (hadana ma u adag yahay).
3. **Badalada pronouns iyo possessives**: Wax ka beddii fiirka: 'I' → 'he/she', 'my' → 'his/her', iyada oo kale.
4. **Badalada erayada wakhtiga iyo meeshay ku noqdeen**: today → that day; yesterday → the day before / the previous day; tomorrow → the next day / the following day; here → there; now → then.
5. **Su'aalo la soo xigtay**: Xilli ka beddii qiyaastii la soo xigtay iyo isticmaal 'if/whether' si/maya, iyo erayada su'aalda ee ku filan su'aalaha furaynta. Ma isticmaali doona 'do/does/did': 'Where does he live?' → 'She asked where he lived.'
6. **Amaro iyo codsiyado**: Isticmaal 'tell/ask + object + infinitive': 'He told me to close the door.' Ma isticmaali 'that'.
7. **Fiilka modal**: 'would', 'could', 'might', 'should', 'ought to' ma ay beddi doonin. 'must' waxay ku noqdeen ama ku beddi doontaa 'had to' si fiican u leh.

concept_examples.text: She said she had finished the report the day before.
concept_examples.translation: Ayay tidhi inay bixiyey xogta maalintii hore.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃiː sed ʃiː hæd ˈfɪnɪʃt ðə rɪˈpɔːrt ðə deɪ bɪˈfɔːr/

concept_examples.text: He asked if I could help him with the project.
concept_examples.translation: Wuxuu wayday haddii la qabilay inuu ugu caawiyo sharciga.
concept_examples.phonetic: /hiː æskt ɪf aɪ kʊd hɛlp hɪm wɪð ðə ˈprɒdʒɛkt/

concept_examples.text: They told us to wait outside.
concept_examples.translation: Waxay nagu yidhaa inaan nugu sugno dhexdee.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ toʊld ʌs tə weɪt ˌaʊtˈsaɪd/

concept_examples.text: She warned that the meeting might be postponed.
concept_examples.translation: Ayay diideysey in tirada ay noqon doontaa si aan la sameyn karo.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃiː wɔːrnd ðæt ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ maɪt biː poʊstˈpoʊnd/

common_error.wrong: She said me that she was tired.
common_error.correct: She told me that she was tired.
common_error.correct_alt: She said that she was tired.
common_error.explanation: Af-Soomaali, 'decir' waxay isticmaalataa object indirect (me dijo), laakiin Ingiriisi ah 'say' ma ay heystaan object personal; 'tell' ayaa isticmaal jira markii la soo xigtay qofku la hadlayo. Sidaa darteed, 'said me' khalad ah ayuu yahay; 'told me' ama 'said' object-less ayaa isticmaal lahaa.

examples.original: Paul said he was going to London the following day.
examples.phonetic: /pɔːl sɛd hiː wɒz ˈɡəʊɪŋ tə ˈlʌndən ðə ˈfɒləʊɪŋ deɪ/
examples.translation: Paul wuxuu yidhi inuu u tago London maalintii dambe.
examples.note: Eeg dhexdhexaadka: 'is going' → 'was going' iyo 'tomorrow' → 'the following day'.

examples.original: She mentioned she had already seen that film.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ˈmɛnʃənd ʃiː hæd ɔːlˈrɛdi siːn ðæt fɪlm/
examples.translation: Ayay tidhi inay hadda arkay fiilmigaas.
examples.note: Present perfect 'have seen' waxay noqotay past perfect 'had seen'.

examples.original: They claimed they would finish the project by Friday.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ kleɪmd ðeɪ wʊd ˈfɪnɪʃ ðə ˈprɒdʒɛkt baɪ ˈfraɪdeɪ/
examples.translation: Waxay yidhaa inay dhaman doonaan sharciga maalintii jimcaha.
examples.note: 'Will' waxay noqotay 'would' qiyaastii la soo xigtay.

examples.original: She asked where the nearest bank was.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː æskt wɛə ðə ˈnɪərɪst bæŋk wɒz/
examples.translation: Ayay wayday meeshii ay noqoto inay ku jiraan bankiga ugu dhow.
examples.note: Su'aalaha qiyaastii la soo xigtay, xilliga ayuu noqotaa qiyaastii la soo xigtay: 'was' dhammaadka, ma aha 'was the bank'.

examples.original: He wondered if she had received his email.
examples.phonetic: /hiː ˈwʌndərd ɪf ʃiː hæd rɪˈsiːvd hɪz ˈiːmeɪl/
examples.translation: Wuxuu wayday haddii ay helay email-ka.
examples.note: Su'aalaha si/maya 'if' ama 'whether' ayaa isticmaal lahaa.

examples.original: They asked us why we hadn't called earlier.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ æskt ʌs waɪ wiː ˈhædnt kɔːld ˈɜːrliər/
examples.translation: Waxay weydiiyeen maxay ku noqdeen inaan u yeedhno horays.
examples.note: Su'aalaha asalka 'Why didn't you call?' waxay noqotay 'why we hadn't called'.

levels.label: Reported Commands, Requests and Suggestions
levels.translation: Amaro, codsiyado iyo soo jeedo qiyaastii la soo xigtay

examples.original: The teacher told us to stop talking.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈtiːtʃər toʊld ʌs tə stɒp ˈtɔːkɪŋ/
examples.translation: Macallimku wuxuu nagu yidhi inaan joogno hadalkii.
examples.note: Amaro 'tell + object + infinitive' ayaa isticmaal lahaa.

examples.original: She asked me to open the window.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː æskt miː tə ˈəʊpən ðə ˈwɪndəʊ/
examples.translation: Ayay i codsatay inaan furto shubaashada.
examples.note: Codsiyado 'ask + object + infinitive' ayaa isticmaal lahaa.

examples.original: He suggested going to the cinema.
examples.phonetic: /hiː səˈdʒɛstɪd ˈɡəʊɪŋ tə ðə ˈsɪnəmə/
examples.translation: Wuxuu soo jeeday inay u taga cinema.
examples.note: Soo jeedo, gerund 'suggest + -ing' ama 'that + should' ayaa isticmaal lahaa.

examples.original: She recommended that we book early.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ˌrɛkəˈmɛndɪd ðæt wiː bʊk ˈɜːrli/
examples.translation: Ayay diideysey inaan u hayno haybad dhammaadka.
examples.note: 'Recommend' 'that + clause' fiilka asalka (subjunctive) ayaa isticmaal lahaa.

translations.so: Qiyaastii la soo xigtay ee adag

title: Inversion for Emphasis / Inversion for Emphasis
bridge: Faransiis, inooji aannu u isticmaalo waxa adag oo ah qalabka cadaan ama dib u eegida qaybaha ("Nunca había visto algo así"). Ingiriisi, mar dhow, markii ay adverbiyaasha xumaan ama xadid (rarely, not only, never, etc.) noqonayaan horumarinta jumbada, waa in laa in la soo jeedo isku halleeya each iyo mid ka mid ah (ama fiilka 'to be'), sida ay jira su'aasha. Inversionkan ma aha mid la doonayo: haddii aad si tixraac u sameynin, jumbada wuxuu ku qaybtaa rasmi ah laakiin qoraalka Ingiriisi ku nool ma aha. Khalaadka caadiga ah ee ah ee ku salaysan af-Isbaanish wuxuu u dhaafaa inuu ka saaraa isku halleeya maxaa yeelay af-Isbaanish ma jiro habka sintaksiga.
rule: Inversion for emphasis wuxuu u dhacaa markii ay adverbi ama hadalad u muujanaayo maana xumaan ama xadid noqonayaan horumarinta jumbada. Waxa ugu caansan yahay: never, rarely, seldom, hardly ever, not only, no sooner, little, under no circumstances, at no time, in no way. Qalabka wuxuu ahayd: [Hadalad xumaan/xadid] + mid ka mid ah (do/does/did, have/has, will, can, etc.) + each + fiilka ugu weyn. Haddii mid ka mid ah ma jirin, 'do' waxaa lagu darayaa hal-ku-dhigay ama 'did' dhexdeeda (ilaa 'to be', oo lagu soo jeeda si toos ah). 'Not only' waxaa lagu isticmaalaa isku halleeya qaybta koowaad: "Not only did she sing, but she also danced". 'No sooner' waxaa lagu isticmaalaa dhexdeeda ee dhexdhexaad ah: "No sooner had we arrived than it started raining". Macdanta wuxuu ku salaysan yahay qoraallada rasmi ah ama qoraallada, laakiin waxaa lagu isticmaalaa siyaasadda iyo shaqooyinka.

concept_examples.text: Not only did she finish the project, but she also presented it brilliantly.
concept_examples.translation: Not only did he finish the project, but he also presented it brilliantly.
concept_examples.phonetic: /nɒt ˈəʊnli dɪd ʃiː ˈfɪnɪʃ ðə ˈprɒdʒekt bʌt ʃiː ˈɔːlsəʊ prɪˈzentɪd ɪt ˈbrɪliəntli/

concept_examples.text: Rarely do we see such dedication in our team.
concept_examples.translation: Rarely do we see such dedication in our team.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈreəli duː wiː siː sʌtʃ ˌdedɪˈkeɪʃn ɪn ˈaʊə tiːm/

concept_examples.text: Never have I encountered a more challenging problem.
concept_examples.translation: Never have I encountered a more difficult problem.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈnevə hæv aɪ ɪnˈkaʊntəd ə mɔː ˈtʃælɪndʒɪŋ ˈprɒbləm/

concept_examples.text: Under no circumstances should you disclose this information.
concept_examples.translation: Under no circumstances should you disclose this information.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈʌndə nəʊ ˈsɜːkəmstænsɪz ʃʊd juː dɪsˈkləʊz ðɪs ˌɪnfəˈmeɪʃn/

common_error.wrong: Rarely we see such beautiful sunsets.
common_error.correct: Rarely do we see such beautiful sunsets.
common_error.correct_alt: We rarely see such beautiful sunsets.
common_error.explanation: Khalaadku wuxuu u dhacaa maxaa yeelay af-Isbaanish "Rara vez vemos..." qalabka waxaa lagu sameeyaa ilmaan mid ka mid ah, iyo xaaladdu wuxuu u tarjumayaa si adag. Ingiriisi, markii ay adverbi xumaan noqonayo horumarinta jumbada, waa in la isticmaalo isku halleeya 'do' (hal-ku-dhigay). Badanka kala duwan oo aan la isku halaynayn wuxuu ahayd adverbi-ga ku soo dhowaada each ("We rarely see..."), oo ah qalabka ugu caansan ee ah ee ku salaysan hadalka maalin-maalin. In aad u xagin khalaadka, xusuuso: haddii adverbi-ga noqonayo horumar, waa inaad isku halaysid; haddii aad raadin doonayn inaad isku halaysid, adverbi-ga wuxuu ku guuleystaa goostaan kale.

levels.label: Basic Inversion with Negative Adverbs
levels.translation: Isku halleeya cadaadisan ah oo adverbiyaasha xumaan

examples.original: Never have I been so happy.
examples.phonetic: /ˈnevə hæv aɪ biːn səʊ ˈhæpi/
examples.translation: Never have I been so happy.
examples.note: Waxaa lagu isticmaalaa 'have' si ay u noqoto mid ka mid ah maxaa yeelay hal-ku-dhigay wuxuu u baahan yahay mid ka mid ah. Af-Isbaanish, 'nunca' waa in la sii socdo fiilka ilmaan in la isku halayo.

examples.original: Hardly ever does he arrive on time.
examples.phonetic: /ˈhɑːdli ˈevə dʌz hiː əˈraɪv ɒn taɪm/
examples.translation: Hardly ever does he arrive on time.
examples.note: Eeg ama 'he' (saddexad) mid ka mid ah wuxuu ah 'does', 'do'.

examples.original: Little did we know about the plan.
examples.phonetic: /ˈlɪtəl dɪd wiː nəʊ əˈbaʊt ðə plæn/
examples.translation: Little did we know about the plan.
examples.note: Adverbi-ga 'little' oo maana xumaan (little) ayaa u muujayaan isku halleeya. Af-Isbaanish waxaa lagu yidhaahdaa 'poco sabíamos' ilmaan qalabka dib u eegisay.

examples.original: Not only did they win the match, but they also broke the record.
examples.phonetic: /nɒt ˈəʊnli dɪd ðeɪ wɪn ðə mætʃ bʌt ðeɪ ˈɔːlsəʊ brəʊk ðə ˈrekɔːd/
examples.translation: Not only did they win the match, but they also broke the record.
examples.note: Isku halleeya wuxuu u dhacaa qaybta koowaad 'did'. Qaybta labaad (but they also) ma ay isku halaynyn.

examples.original: No sooner had the meeting started than the fire alarm went off.
examples.phonetic: /nəʊ ˈsuːnə hæd ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ ˈstɑːtɪd ðæn ðə ˈfaɪər əˈlɑːm went ɒf/
examples.translation: No sooner had the meeting started than the fire alarm went off.
examples.note: 'No sooner' waxaa lagu isticmaalaa dhexdeeda ee dhexdhexaad ah (had + participle) iyo isku halleeya. Af-Isbaanish waxaa lagu isticmaalo 'apenas' ama 'no bien' ilmaan qalabka dib u eegisay.

examples.original: Not only is she intelligent, but she is also very creative.
examples.phonetic: /nɒt ˈəʊnli ɪz ʃiː ɪnˈtelɪdʒənt bʌt ʃiː ɪz ˈɔːlsəʊ ˈveri kriˈeɪtɪv/
examples.translation: Not only is she intelligent, but she is also very creative.
examples.note: 'To be' isku halleeya wuxuu u dhacaa si toos ah: fiilku wuxuu u soo dhowaada each ilmaan mid ka mid ah 'do'.

levels.label: Advanced Inversion with Negative Prepositional Phrases
levels.translation: Isku halleeya adag oo ah qaybaha prepositional xumaan

examples.original: Under no circumstances should you open that door.
examples.phonetic: /ˈʌndə nəʊ ˈsɜːkəmstænsɪz ʃʊd juː ˈəʊpən ðæt dɔː/
examples.translation: Under no circumstances should you open that door.
examples.note: Qalabkan wuxuu u adag oo ah iyo lagu isticmaalo waxbarashada, qaynuunnada ama hadalka. Af-Isbaanish waxaa lagu yidhaahdaa 'bajo ninguna circunstancia debes...' ilmaan isku halleeya.

examples.original: At no time did the manager admit his mistake.
examples.phonetic: /æt nəʊ taɪm dɪd ðə ˈmænɪdʒər ədˈmɪt hɪz mɪˈsteɪk/
examples.translation: At no time did the manager admit his mistake.
examples.note: Hadalad 'at no time' wuxuu u baahan yahay isku halleeya 'did' dhexdeeda. Af-Isbaanish goostaan 'en ningún momento' waa in la sii socdo.

examples.original: In no way can we accept such a proposal.
examples.phonetic: /ɪn nəʊ weɪ kæn wiː əkˈsept sʌtʃ ə prəˈpəʊzl/
examples.translation: In no way can we accept such a proposal.
examples.note: Waxaa lagu isticmaalo fiilka modal oo ah 'can', 'could', 'should'. Isku halleeya wuxuu u dhacaa modal.

examples.original: Seldom have I seen such a magnificent performance.
examples.phonetic: /ˈseldəm hæv aɪ siːn sʌtʃ ə mæɡˈnɪfɪsənt pəˈfɔːməns/
examples.translation: Rarely have I seen such a magnificent performance.
examples.note: 'Seldom' wuxuu la mid ah 'rarely' laakiin wuxuu u adag. Af-Isbaanish waxaa lagu isticmaalo 'rara vez' ama 'raramente' ilmaan in la beddelo qaybaha.

title: Cleft sentences (It is/was... that) / Eachadaadka qaybaha (Waxaa... in)
bridge: Faransiiska, inaan u xusuusan qayb walba waa inay isticmaalayaan awoodda 'Waxaa... in' sida 'Waxaa Jjuun oo sameeyey' ama 'Waxaa halkan aan noolnahay'. Ingiriishi, wuxuu u sameeyaa 'it' + fiilka 'to be' + qaybta la xusay + 'that/who' + qaybta ka hadhay. Tifaacadda ugu muhiima ah ayaa in Ingiriishi, ilaa 'it' waa in la isticmaalo (ma la qalmooni karo), iyo in 'that' waxay u badali karo 'who' dadka, laakiin 'which' ma isticmaali karo. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, qoraalka wuxuu u adag yahay in la isticmaalo in la qoro faransiiska, oo ah qoraal oo fiilku u badali karo.
rule: Eachadaadka qaybaha (Cleft sentences) waxay u isticmaalayaan in la xusayo qayb walba oo kooban oo kooban. Qoraalka ugu muhiima ah wuxuu ku jiraa: 'It' + fiilka 'to be' (halka heesa ama halka dambe) + qaybta la doonayo in la xusayo (sujeto, objeto, complemento de tiempo, lugar, etc.) + ilaa relativo ('that', 'who', 'whom', 'whose') + qaybta ka hadhay. Dadka, waxaa la isticmaali karo 'who' (sujeto) ama 'whom' (objeto, haddii ay noqoto formal). Waxyaalaha iyo waxyaabaha kale, 'that' (ama 'which' halka ugu adag). Halka heesa waxaa la isticmaalaa 'is', halka dambe 'was'. 'It's' ma isticmaali karo halka dambe (waxay qalad), waxaa la isticmaalaa 'it was'. Qaybta la xusay waxay noqon kartaa magaca, ilaa, jidh ama xataa xukun. Misal: 'Waxaa Maryan oo i yeedhay.' / 'Waxaa malalin oo aan ku faraxsanahay ugu badnaan.' / 'Waxaa Pariis oo aan la kulmaynay.' / 'Waxaa aad oo aan timid.' Misal kale waxay ku jiraan 'what' (what-clauses): 'Wax aan u baahanahay waa qaxooti.' Halka, 'it' ma isticmaali karo, laakiin 'what' halka ugu horeysay. Misal kale: 'Sababta oo...', 'Wax oo...', 'Qof oo...', laakiin ugu muhiimsan waxay 'it' iyo 'what'. Tifaac: 'it' ma isticmaali karo markii la xusayo fiilka (qoraal kale waxaa la isticmaalaa 'what...do'). Halka aanu, waxaa la isticmaalaa 'It wasn't...' ama 'It isn't...'.

concept_examples.text: It was John who broke the window.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaa Jjuun oo bixiyey shuqulka.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪt wɒz dʒɒn huː brəʊk ðə ˈwɪndəʊ/

concept_examples.text: It is the weather that affects my mood.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaa cimiladu oo u dhaqsiiya madaxayga.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ðə ˈweðər ðæt əˈfekts maɪ muːd/

concept_examples.text: It was in 2005 that they got married.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaa 2005 oo ay guursadeen.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪt wɒz ɪn tuː ˈθaʊzənd ənd faɪv ðæt ðeɪ ɡɒt ˈmærid/

concept_examples.text: What I really need is a holiday.
concept_examples.translation: Wax aan u baahanahay waa fasax.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wɒt aɪ ˈrɪəli niːd ɪz ə ˈhɒlədeɪ/

common_error.wrong: Fue Juan que rompió la ventana.
common_error.correct: It was John who broke the window.
common_error.correct_alt: It was John that broke the window.
common_error.explanation: Khalaadadadu ugu muhiimsan waa in la tarjumiyo 'Waxaa Jjuun oo...' oo aan isticmaalin 'it' Ingiriishi. Ingiriishi, qoraalka wuxuu u baahan yahay in la isticmaalo 'it' halka ugu horeysay. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, faransiiska waxay isticmaalayaan 'que' dadka iyo waxyaalaha, laakiin Ingiriishi dadka waxaa la doortaa 'who' (haddii 'that' ay noqoto, 'who' waa ugu dhexeeya). Waxaanan u xusuusan in fiilka 'to be' wuxuu u dhexeeyaa waqtiga iyo shakhsiya: 'is' halka heesa, 'was' halka dambe, 'was' ma isticmaali karo 'it' halka heesa (qalad: 'It is was'). Inaad ka saartid, waxaa inaad diwaansho qoraal 'it' + 'be' + qaybta la xusay + 'who/that'.

examples.original: It is my sister who knows the secret.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz maɪ ˈsɪstər huː nəʊz ðə ˈsiːkrɪt/
examples.translation: Waxaa walaashay oo ogay sirta.
examples.note: Waxay isticmaalayaan 'who' dadka, 'that' ay isticmaali karo.

examples.original: It was the noise that woke me up.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt wɒz ðə nɔɪz ðæt wəʊk miː ʌp/
examples.translation: Waxaa suurta oo i soo jiifsaday.
examples.note: Waxyaalaha, 'that' (ama 'which' halka ugu adag, laakiin 'that' waa ugu dhexeeya).

examples.original: It was your mother who called earlier.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt wɒz jɔː ˈmʌðər huː kɔːld ˈɜːliər/
examples.translation: Waxaa hooyadaa oo i yeedhay ilaa ugu horeysay.
examples.note: Xusuuso qoraalka: it + was + qaybta + who + qaybta ka hadhay.

levels.label: Cleft sentences with time, place and reason
levels.translation: Eachadaadka qaybaha waqtiga, meesha iyo sababta

examples.original: It is in autumn that the leaves fall.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ɪn ˈɔːtəm ðæt ðə liːvz fɔːl/
examples.translation: Waxaa dhacdo oo ay duubadahu ku noqdeen.
examples.note: Waqtiga, 'when' ma isticmaali karo eachadaadka qaybaha, laakiin 'that'.

examples.original: It was at the station that we said goodbye.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt wɒz æt ðə ˈsteɪʃən ðæt wiː sed ɡʊdˈbaɪ/
examples.translation: Waxaa steshini oo aan u soo baxnay.
examples.note: Meesha, waxay isticmaalayaan 'that' (ma 'where' eachadaadka 'it').

examples.original: It is because of the rain that the match was cancelled.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz bɪˈkɒz əv ðə reɪn ðæt ðə mætʃ wɒz ˈkænsəld/
examples.translation: Waxaa roobka oo lagu xiriiray macbudka.
examples.note: Sababta, 'because of' + 'that'.

examples.original: What I want is a new car.
examples.phonetic: /wɒt aɪ wɒnt ɪz ə njuː kɑːr/
examples.translation: Wax aan doonayo waa qalab cusub.
examples.note: Qoraalka 'what + xukun' + 'be' + qaybta la xusay. 'It' ma isticmaali karo.

examples.original: What she did was apologize.
examples.phonetic: /wɒt ʃiː dɪd wɒz əˈpɒlədʒaɪz/
examples.translation: Wax uu sameeyey waa u adeegsanay.
examples.note: Haddii la xusayo fiilka, waxaa la isticmaalaa 'what' + 'do' + 'be' + fiilka infinitive.

examples.original: The reason why I left is that I was tired.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈriːzən waɪ aɪ left ɪz ðæt aɪ wɒz ˈtaɪəd/
examples.translation: Sababta aan tashadeeyey waa inaan aad u nacay.
examples.note: Isticmaalka 'the reason why' sida badal.

title: Nominalisation: Turning Verbs and Adjectives into Nouns / Isku-bedelidda magaca: Bedelka Fiil iyo Sifa oo ah Magaca
bridge: Ingiriisi, isku-bedelidda magaca waxay u dhexeeya inay noqoto qoraalada rasmi ah iyo xaqiiqo leh: 'the discovery of' waxaa la jeclaa 'they discovered'. Kala duwan oo ah af-Isbaanish, meesha aan fiil ku isticmaalno magac (el descubrir), Ingiriisi waxay isticmaalaa dhowr ku dhowaad -tion, -ment, -ness. Fiirso: fiil kasta ma aha magac la soo saaro oo leh dhankaas oo la mid ah, iyo midka erayada ku beddelaya: Ingiriisi, shirkii (ama 'of') wuxuu u horreeya magaca, markaasaa af-Isbaanish 'de' ayaa la isticmaalaya.
rule:
B2, ku qabto xaaladdan:
1. Fiil → magaca oo leh dhowr ku dhowaad: -tion (inform → information), -ment (develop → development), -ance/-ence (perform → performance), -al (approve → approval), -ure (fail → failure).
2. Sifa → magaca: -ness (happy → happiness), -ity (active → activity), -th (strong → strength), -ce (important → importance).
3. Xaalad la xiriira: choose → choice, believe → belief, prove → proof, lose → loss.
4. Isticmaal: Ingiriisi rasmi ah 'the implementation of the plan' waxaa la jeclaa 'they implemented the plan'. 'Make' + magac: 'make a decision' oo aan 'decide'.
5. Xaalad aan la mid ah: fiil baahi ku jira (change → change), iyo magaca leh maana xusuusan (relation vs. relationship).

concept_examples.text: The discovery of penicillin changed medicine.
concept_examples.translation: Isku-bedelidda penicillin baa bedelay dhaw.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə dɪˈskʌvəri əv ˌpɛnɪˈsɪlɪn tʃeɪndʒd ˈmɛdɪsɪn/

concept_examples.text: Her happiness was obvious to everyone.
concept_examples.translation: Farxaddiisii wuxuu ahaa waajibi in la ogaado.
concept_examples.phonetic: /hɜːr ˈhæpinəs wɒz ˈɒbviəs tə ˈɛvrɪwʌn/

concept_examples.text: The development of new technologies is rapid.
concept_examples.translation: Horumarinta ticono cusub waxay ku fidnaan.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə dɪˈvɛləpmənt əv njuː tɛkˈnɒlədʒiz ɪz ˈræpɪd/

concept_examples.text: We need a decision by tomorrow.
concept_examples.translation: Waad u baahan tahay go'aan si loo dhigo berri.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wiː niːd ə dɪˈsɪʒən baɪ təˈmɒroʊ/

common_error.wrong: The discovery of the new planet was made by NASA.
common_error.correct: The discovery of the new planet was made by NASA.
common_error.explanation: Miskaan waa saxo; si fiican, khalad u dhexeeya waxaa isticmaalaya fiil meesha aan magac u baahan yahay: 'Waxay helay arimaha cusub' qoraal rasmi ah oo aan 'Isku-bedelidda arimaha cusub...'. Af-Isbaanish waxay ku tirtaa 'el descubrir' ama isticmaalaa fiil oo ah magac: 'The discovering of...' waxaana qalad ah. Inaad ka saartid, ogeysii dhowrku dhowaadka magaca iyo fiilka si aad u bedeliso jirka fiilka oo ah magaca.

levels.label: Verb to Noun Suffixes
levels.translation: Dhowrku dhowaadka fiilka oo ah magaca

examples.original: The invention of the internet changed communication.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ɪnˈvɛnʃən əv ði ˈɪntəˌnɛt tʃeɪndʒd kəˌmjuːnɪˈkeɪʃən/
examples.translation: Isku-bedelidda internet baa bedelay wadaagga.
examples.note: Dhowrka -tion waxay bedelay 'invent' oo ah 'invention'. Af-Isbaanishna waxaynu leennu hayno -ción, laakiin fiirso qorista.

examples.original: His improvement in English was remarkable.
examples.phonetic: /hɪz ɪmˈpruːvmənt ɪn ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ wɒz rɪˈmɑːrkəbl/
examples.translation: Hordharcantii Ingiriisii wuxuu ahaa waajibi.
examples.note: Dhowrka -ment: improve → improvement. Af-Isbaanish waxaynu ku isticmaalno 'hordharcanta' oo aan dhowrku dhowaad ahayn.

examples.original: The appearance of the actor caused excitement.
examples.phonetic: /ði əˈpɪərəns əv ði ˈæktər kɔːzd ɪkˈsaɪtmənt/
examples.translation: Tusaalehaadaada waxay u dhaxeeyey xasillooni.
examples.note: Dhowrka -ance: appear → appearance. Ha iska daayo 'apparition' (ruux).

levels.label: Adjective to Noun Suffixes
levels.translation: Dhowrku dhowaadka sifa oo ah magaca

examples.original: Her kindness made everyone feel welcome.
examples.phonetic: /hɜːr ˈkaɪndnəs meɪd ˈɛvrɪwʌn fiːl ˈwɛlkəm/
examples.translation: Nasiibadiisu wuxuu u oggolaaday in qof kasta u soo dhowaado.
examples.note: Dhowrka -ness: kind → kindness. Af-Isbaanish waxaynu ku isticmaalno '-idad' ama '-ura'.

examples.original: The importance of education cannot be underestimated.
examples.phonetic: /ði ɪmˈpɔːrtəns əv ˌɛdʒuˈkeɪʃən kænɒt biː ˌʌndərˈɛstɪmeɪtɪd/
examples.translation: Nasiibadiisu waa mid aan la qaladin karin.
examples.note: Dhowrka -ance sifa -ant: important → importance. Fiirso 'e' dhinaca dambe.

examples.original: She showed great strength in difficult times.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ʃoʊd ɡreɪt strɛŋkθ ɪn ˈdɪfɪkəlt taɪmz/
examples.translation: Ayay u tusay quudhaan weyn waqti dhib.
examples.note: Dhowrka -th: strong → strength. Khalad aan la mid ah, ha isticmaal '-ness'.

examples.original: The implementation of the new policy was delayed.
examples.phonetic: /ði ˌɪmplɪmɛnˈteɪʃən əv ðə njuː ˈpɒləsi wɒz dɪˈleɪd/
examples.translation: Isku-bedelidda siyaasadda cusub waxay ku fidnaystay.
examples.note: Ingiriisi rasmi ah 'implementation' waxaa la jeclaa 'waxay soo saareen'.

examples.original: There has been an increase in unemployment.
examples.phonetic: /ðɛr hæz biːn ən ˈɪnkriːs ɪn ˌʌnɪmˈplɔɪmənt/
examples.translation: Waxaa jira buuxinta la'aantada.
examples.note: Qoraal oo leh 'there has been' + magac. Ha odhan 'la'aantadu waa badan' qoraal rasmi ah.

examples.original: The failure of the talks led to conflict.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈfeɪljər əv ðə tɔːks lɛd tə ˈkɒnflɪkt/
examples.translation: Dajinta wareejinta ayaa u baxay la xiriir.
examples.note: Fiil aan la mid ah: fail → failure. Ha odhan 'the failing'.
